fact: SARS's answers to bidders on RFP07/2026 require the cloud component to be deployed in a South African region for data residency and sovereignty, hosted in a SARS-controlled tenancy to preserve key management and exit rights, and refuse off-shore SaaS tenancies storing SARS data.
title: RFP07/2026 The Procurement of a Master Data Management and Data Governance Solution: Questions & Answers, Communication 3/3
